findings.title: Model router call log file is missing

evidence.observation: Model router call log file does not exist at configured path /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl (call_log_exists: false, call_log_size_mb: null)

proposed_action.description: Ensure model router creates and writes request telemetry to call_log.jsonl for observability and audit trails

findings.expected_benefit: Restores call logging visibility, latency tracking, and operational auditing for model invocations

findings.title: Stubbed quality anomalies query in quality forecasting

findings.title: Direct external Gemini API invocation bypassing model router

evidence.observation: Emergency alert module calls call_gemini directly using GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable rather than going through the local model router

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM synthesis requests through the model router service to preserve centralized routing policy and fallback capabilities

findings.expected_benefit: Centralizes model routing, enables cost/usage monitoring, and allows graceful fallbacks during API outages
